Chris Thoms, President, Local #279, requested a recess to review the proposal at 7:45 p.m., and Union members vacated chambers to the HR conference room to caucus.

Mayor Collins confirmed mutual understanding of the vacation language, and both parties a greed to the revised terms including MERP language . Regarding the MERP,
Mayor Collins indicated general agreement, with the exception that the City would not be required to contribute for firefighters not actively working or contributing.
Mayor Collins declined due to differences between daytime and platoon shifts.
